purpose: Create deterministic, point-in-time, source-addressed fundamental observations from SEC XBRL Company Facts without training on Earth scores, narrative judgments or invented financial labels.

authority.primary: SEC EDGAR XBRL Company Facts API
authority.customTaxonomyPolicy: Company Facts exposes standard taxonomy facts only; missing extension-only disclosures remain unknown rather than inferred.

pointInTime.rule: A source fact is eligible only when filed <= asOf.
pointInTime.availabilityPrecision: SEC Company Facts exposes filed date, not acceptance timestamp, for each fact.
pointInTime.sameDayPolicy: Conservative: a fact with only a filing date becomes eligible after the end of that UTC filing date.
pointInTime.economicContextIdentity: taxonomy + tag + unit + start/end; fy/fp are filing metadata and do not create a new economic fact.
pointInTime.periodClassification: Periodic form is authoritative for annual vs interim classification; duration is secondary within interim filings.

derivedPolicy.rule: Derived values are mechanical transformations of selected source facts only.
derivedPolicy.note: A later amendment to one input cannot be combined with a stale value from another filing; incompatible inputs yield unknown.
derivedPolicy.debtPolicy: No total-debt synthesis in v1; debt/borrowings concepts remain separate until semantic component coverage is audited.

governance.promotionRequires: separate audited governance change after truth-pipeline validation

sourceFactSchema.note: Instant facts normally have no start; some SEC facts omit frame/fiscal focus. Null stays null.

periodicFormsPolicy: 8-K facts are excluded from normalized fundamentals v1 so preliminary/current-report facts cannot silently supersede periodic financial statements.

freshnessPolicy.rule: Record mechanical calendar-day age only. V1 does not label a fact fresh/stale or impute a newer value.
